;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Timeline of the Israeli–Palestinian conflict|Terrorism in Israel]]
**[[Petah Tikva]] resident Zohar Zuaretz is indicted on counterterror charges for [[right-wing terrorism|far right]] [[social media]] posts in which he spoke of killing Arabs. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/terror-charges-filed-against-israeli-who-dreamed-of-decapitating-arab-babies/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
**[[Ministry of Defense (Israel)|Israeli Defense Minister]] [[Avigdor Liberman]] declares the Iliya Institute, a [[Jerusalem]] community centre, to be a terror organisation operating on behalf of the [[Democratic Front for the Liberation of Palestine]]. [http://www.jpost.com/Breaking-News/Liberman-labels-east-Jerusalem-community-center-a-terror-establishment-549970 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
*[[Terrorism in Malaysia]]
**[[Malaysia]] announces the arrest of six alleged [[ISIL|Islamic State]] members accused of plotting to abduct and murder police and assault places of worship. Authorities appeal for information on four more suspects. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/malaysia-police-tracking-down-4-dangerous-islamic-state-linked-10142590 (Channel NewsAsia)]
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**[[Russia]] denies interfering with the site of [[2018 Douma chemical weapons attack|a chemical weapons attack]] in [[Douma, Syria|Douma]], [[Syria]], and says a nine-member [[Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons]] team currently waiting in [[Damascus]] will be allowed to visit on Wednesday. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-43783427 (BBC)]
**[[Syria]]n state media [[Syrian Arab News Agency|''SANA'']] reports that the [[Syrian Air Defense Force]] has intercepted several missiles fired at [[Shayrat Airbase]] in the [[Homs Governorate]]. The [[United States|U.S.]] denies any involvement. [https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/syria/syrian-state-tv-says-missile-attack-on-air-base-thwarted-1.6009200 (''Haaretz'')]
*[[2018 Gaza border protests]]
**[[Israel]] announces sanctions on the owners of fourteen bus companies, and their families, in response to the firms transporting [[Palestinian people|Palestinian]] protestors to the [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]-Israel border. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/israel-sanctions-owners-of-buses-used-by-gaza-protesters/2018/04/16/bbe2b4b4-419f-11e8-b2dc-b0a403e4720a_story.html?noredirect=on&utm_term=.e534755da781 (''The Washington Post'')]

;Arts and culture
*[[2018 Pulitzer Prize]]
**The annual [[Pulitzer Prize]]s, which celebrate [[United States|US]] journalism, are awarded. ''[[The New York Times]]'' wins the most with three. Pieces on [[Donald Trump]] and the [[MeToo movement|#MeToo movement]] feature prominently. [https://www.theguardian.com/culture/2018/apr/16/kendrick-lamar-pulitzer-prize-weinstein-new-york-times (''The Guardian'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Grenfell Tower fire]]
**A leaked draft report by fire investigators BRS Global for the [[Metropolitan Police]] reveals new details of mistakes in the construction and refurbishment of [[Grenfell Tower]] in [[London]]. As well as flammable cladding the report finds errors in window and cavity installation. It concludes the fire would have not spread beyond a single flat and all 71 victims would have survived had refurbishment not been performed, and that victims may also have survived had they sought refuge behind fire doors protecting waste chute rooms on each floor. [https://www.standard.co.uk/news/london/shock-grenfell-dossier-reveals-disastrous-refurbishment-turned-tower-into-a-tinderbox-a3814866.html (''The Evening Standard'')] [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/grenfell-tower-refurbishment-structure-fire-hazard-building-regulations-leaked-report-latest-updates-a8306876.html (''The Independent'')] [https://www.standard.co.uk/news/london/grenfell-tower-report-how-the-fire-began-on-the-fourth-floor-and-spread-throughout-the-block-a3814831.html (''The Evening Standard'')]
*[[List of disasters in Indonesia|Disasters in Indonesia]]
**A warehouse in [[Cirebon]], [[Indonesia]], collapses onto a neighbouring arts centre where teenagers were preparing for a dance show. At least seven people die, six of them children. [http://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/seven-killed-in-indonesia-building-collapse (''The Straits Times'')]
**The Indonesia [[People's Representative Council]] convenes a meeting to discuss [[2018 Balikpapan oil spill|the ongoing oil spill]] in Balikpapan Bay, [[East Kalimantan]]. [https://en.tempo.co/read/news/2018/04/16/055917631/House-Convenes-Meeting-on-Balikpapan-Oil-Spill (Tempo)]
*[[List of shipwrecks in 2018|Shipping accidents in 2018]]
**An initial report on a collision between [[container ship]]s MV ''Tolten'' and MV '' Hamburg Bay'' near [[Karachi]], [[Pakistan]], that caused millions of [[Indian rupee|rupees]] in damage and lost cargo last month suggests errors by MV ''Tolten''s captain caused the collision and better [[tugboat|tug]] provision by Karachi Port would have prevented it. [https://www.geo.tv/latest/191341-karachi-ship-collision-initial-report-holds-captain-responsible (Geo)]
**Firefighters reopen the sealed [[Korean Peninsula|Korea]]n fishing ship FV ''Dong Won 701'' in the [[timaru|Port of Timaru]], [[New Zealand]], in a bid to finally extinguish the fire that broke out on April 9. [http://home.nzcity.co.nz/news/article.aspx?id=267628&cat=1033&fm=newsmain%2Cnarts (NZCity.co.nz)]
*[[List of rail accidents (2010–present)#2018|Railway accidents in 2018]]
** Four [[Elephant|elephants]] are killed after being hit by a freight train near a Bagadihi Forest Range area in [[Jharsuguda district]] in the [[India]]n state of [[Odisha]]. [http://www.tribuneindia.com/news/nation/four-elephants-die-after-being-hit-by-train-in-odisha/574784.html (''The Tribune Chandigarh'')]

;Health and environment
*An international team researching a [[plastic]]-consuming [[bacterium]] discovered in 2016 at a [[Japan]]ese [[landfill]] site announce the accidental synthesis of an artificial [[enzyme]] that breaks down plastics more efficiently than the bacterium. The team suggest the [[molecule]] could be used for environmentally sound plastics disposal. [https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2018/apr/16/scientists-accidentally-create-mutant-enzyme-that-eats-plastic-bottles (''The Guardian'')]

;International relations
*[[April 2018 inter-Korean summit|2018 inter-Korean summit]]
**[[South Korea]] is expected to open a press center and online platform in preparations for the summit with [[North Korea]]. [http://nwww.koreaherald.com/view.php?ud=20180416000404 (''The Korean Herald'')]
**The summit is expected to set the tone for the [[2018 North Korea–United States summit|North Korea–United States summit]] later this year. [http://english.yonhapnews.co.kr/northkorea/2018/04/14/86/0401000000AEN20180414002200315F.html (Yonhap News Agency)]

;Law and crime
*[[Crime in India]]
**Eight people, including a juvenile and a caretaker for a local temple, go on trial in [[Kathua]], [[Jammu and Kashmir (state)|Jammu and Kashmir]], accused of abducting an eight-year-old girl, keeping her captive, sexually abusing her, and murdering her in a high-profile case that has already been the subject of nationwide protests and pretrial [[Supreme Court of India|Supreme Court]] proceedings. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/trial-in-kathua-rape-murder-case-begins-monday/articleshow/63774421.cms (''The Times of India'')]
*Former [[President of Andalusia]] and ex-[[Deputy Prime Minister of Spain]] [[Manuel Chaves González]] declares before the court as a key figure in the [[Corruption in Spain#ERE in Andalusia|ERE corruption scandal]]. [https://politica.elpais.com/politica/2018/04/16/actualidad/1523863505_834352.html (''El País'')]
*A judge in [[Ragusa, Sicily|Ragusa]], [[Sicily]], [[Italy]], orders the release of a [[Proactiva Open Arms]] migrant [[search and rescue]] ship detained in [[Pozzallo]] since arriving there on March 18 carrying over 200 migrants rescued from the [[Mediterranean Sea]]. [[Catania]] prosecutors requested the [[Spain|Spanish]] ship's detention alleging involvement in illegal immigration after Proactiva refused to hand the migrants over to [[Libya]]. [http://www.ansa.it/english/news/general_news/2018/04/16/judge-orders-release-of-open-arms-ship-3_4132bc55-7909-4fac-a744-e7341e10644d.html (A.N.S.A.)]
*Police clash with [[KKE]] protestors in [[Athens]], [[Greece]], firing tear gas as the crowd uses angle grinders in an attempt to topple a statue of former U.S. President [[Harry Truman]] in response to the United States' airstrikes in [[Syria]]. Three protestors are injured. [http://www.ekathimerini.com/227699/gallery/ekathimerini/in-images/kke-protesters-try-to-take-down-truman-statue (''eKathimerini'')]
*[[South Carolina]] authorities announce that a riot yesterday at the [[Lee Correctional Institution]] in [[Bishopville]], [[Lee County, South Carolina|Lee County]], killed seven inmates and wounded seventeen others. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2018/apr/16/7-inmates-dead-17-injured-south-carolina-prison-fight (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Terrorism in Turkey]], [[Turkey–United States relations]]
**[[United States|U.S.]] pastor [[Andrew Brunson]] goes on trial in [[Turkey]] facing espionage and terrorism charges that carry a maximum prison term of 35 years. [http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/us-pastor-trial-alleged-terror-ties-spying-turkey-54478886 (ABC News)]
*[[List of journalists killed in Russia]]
**[[Russia]]n investigative journalist Maxim Borodin falls from a window in [[Yekaterinburg]] and dies. Local officials say the death is non-suspicious but ''Novy Den''s chief editor and international monitor OSCE both say he may have been murdered. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-43781351 (BBC)]
*[[The Holocaust]]
**[[Germany|German]] prosecutors charge an unidentified 94-year-old ex-[[Auschwitz]] guard with aiding and abetting 13,335 murders when he was nineteen. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-43782035 (BBC)]

;Science and technology
*[[Explorers program]]
**[[SpaceX]]'s scheduled launch of [[NASA]]'s [[Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite]] (TESS) from [[Cape Canaveral Air Force Station]] is delayed until April 18. TESS is designed to search for [[exoplanet]]s  using the [[transit method]] and is 400 times more powerful than the [[Kepler (spacecraft)|''Kepler'']] space observatory. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-43544205 (BBC)]
*[[China]]'s [[People's Liberation Army]] says the nation's [[J-10C]] [[fighter jet]]s have entered combat service. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2018-04/16/c_137115186.htm (Xinhua)]
*[[Bombardier Aerospace|Bombardier]] announces an increase in range for the [[Global 7000]] business aircraft to 7,700 nautical miles, surpassing the [[Gulfstream G650]] as the longest-range [[private jet]]. [https://montrealgazette.com/business/local-business/aerospace/bombardier-global-7000-claims-crown-as-longest-range-luxury-jet (''The Montreal Gazette'')]
*Archaeologists announce the discovery of a treasure haul potentially linked to 10th Century [[Denmark|Danish]] [[King of Denmark|King]] [[Harald Bluetooth]] in [[Rügen]], [[Germany]]. The initial finds were made by amateur treasure hunters in January and the total haul is the largest of its type. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-43786129 (BBC)]

;Sports
*[[2018 Boston Marathon]]
**[[Desiree Linden|Desiree "Desi" Linden]] becomes the first American woman to [[List of winners of the Boston Marathon|win]] the [[Boston Marathon]] in 33 years. For the men's division, [[Yuki Kawauchi]] of Japan became the first Japanese person to win since 1987. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/olympics/2018/04/16/desi-linden-becomes-first-american-woman-win-boston-marathon-33-years/520562002/ (''USA Today'')]
